You can list your tickets on the website for free.\n</div>\n<div class=\"seo-qa\">\n<div class=\"seo-question\">Are tickets guaranteed on StubHub?</div>\nEvery order is 100% guaranteed on StubHub. StubHub's exclusive FanProtect Guarantee ensures valid tickets or your money back.<br> \nIt's this guarantee that makes us the most trusted ticket marketplace by fans where you can buy and sell with 100% confidence. Our FanProtect Guarantee offers buyers four key benefits:\n<br>\n<div class=\"seo-ul\">\n<div class=\"seo-li\">You will get your tickets in time for the event.</div>\n<div class=\"seo-li\">Your order guarantees a ticket valid for entry into the event.</div>\n<div class=\"seo-li\">If there is an issue with your order, we'll make it right with comparable or better tickets or your money back.</div>\n<div class=\"seo-li\">If your event is canceled and not rescheduled, you'll receive 120% credit or provide the option of a full refund.</div>\n</div>\n</div>\n<div class=\"seo-qa\">\n<div class=\"seo-question\">Can you buy tickets on StubHub without an account? </div>\nYes, you can buy tickets as a guest.\n</div>\n<div class=\"seo-qa\">\n<div class=\"seo-question\">How long does it take to get my StubHub tickets after purchase?</div>\nYou'll get your tickets by your event day or the date on your order's expected arrival date - whichever comes first.\n</div>\n<div class=\"seo-qa\">\n<div class=\"seo-question\">Why can't I see my seats on StubHub? </div>\nSometimes the seller didn't have them when they listed the tickets. You're covered by the FanProtect Guarantee when you buy tickets on StubHub. We guarantee your tickets will be next to each other and get you into the event.\n</div>\n<div class=\"seo-qa\">\n<div class=\"seo-question\">Will StubHub seat you together? </div>\nYes, when you buy tickets on StubHub, your seats are guaranteed to be together.\n</div>\n<div class=\"seo-qa\">\n<div class=\"seo-question\">What Happens if My Event Is Canceled? </div>\nWe'll email you when an event is canceled. We'll add a credit worth 120% of the total amount you paid for the impacted event to your StubHub Wallet. If you would prefer a cash refund, simply go to your StubHub Wallet and click the \"Request cash refund\" button on the appropriate credit. We will process the refund to your original payment method within 5 days.\n</div>\n<div class=\"seo-qa\">\n<div class=\"seo-question\">What Happens if My Event Is Rescheduled? </div>\nWe'll email you when the details are confirmed and will include any info we have on the rescheduled date in the email.
